translations.title: Jackass Number 2: Il Film
translations.overview: Dopo il primo delirante film sulle performance di Johnny Knoxville ed i suoi compagni, la banda al completo ritorna sul grande schermo con nuove e sempre più rischiose prodezze.

Jackass Number Two is a compilation of various stunts, pranks and skits, and essentially has no plot. Chris Pontius, Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O, Bam Margera, and the whole crew return to the screen to raise the stakes higher than ever before.
translations.tagline: Guess who just made number two?
